features.note: Thick, dark brows with a clear arch and angled peak, consistent with the references.
Light silver-grey almond-shaped eyes, matching the references.
Long, straight nose. It reads slightly broader at the tip in this lighting but is within range.
Full lips with a defined cupid's bow and the same closed-mouth smile shape.
Oval face with cheekbones and a tapered chin. The cheeks look slightly fuller and the face marginally wider than in the references, but not round or broad.
Black curly hair past the shoulders, though noticeably shorter than the mid-torso length in the reference sheet.
Curvy figure with a large, full bust, defined waist and wide hips under the fitted dress. Not slimmed relative to the full-body panels.

summary: Strong resemblance on brows, eyes, lips and figure, with a slightly fuller face, slightly darker skin tone and shorter hair keeping it from an unhesitating match; the frame itself is clean and suitable to animate.
